text:
mike: rolling canary for prod release v2.14 -> image redwood/api:release-2.14; canary target 5%
deploy-bot: deploy started: canary-001. Env parity check: FAILED :warning: Missing secret key 'ANALYTICS_KEY' in prod; present in staging. See /ops/secrets for remediation.
lisa: who added that secret to staging?
anna: that was from the analytics onboarding PR last week — they added it to staging via helm values but didn't add to prod secrets rotation.
jordan: ok pause canary. mike, can you abort/hold? we can't have events shipping with missing key.
mike: pausing canary now. helm rollback? or pin image to previous stable?
tom: sre-oncall — prefer pin to previous image and re-run parity check after adding secret. rollback will be easier for customer impact.
lisa: I can push a prod secret sync now if ops approves. It's KMS-wrapped so needs infra review.
anna: @tom @jordan ops approve? it's just a new secret entry, no schema change.
tom: approving manual secret add for this key. steps: 1) create secret in prod KMS, 2) update secret-manager entry, 3) rotate vault token. I'll sit with you.
mike: ok pinning image to redwood/api:release-2.13 for canary. deploy-bot, abort canary rollout and redeploy pinned image.
deploy-bot: action: canary aborted. new deployment queued: redwood/api:release-2.13 -> canary-001. postdeploy parity check scheduled.
jordan: once secret added, we'll unpin and re-run full canary. Create a release note for rollback and change window update.
lisa: doing secret add now, will post logs.
lisa: done — secret created, vault path: secret/prod/analytics_key; rotation queued.
deploy-bot: postdeploy parity check: PASS. prod and staging secrets match for analytics_key. Canary deploy successful for redwood/api:release-2.13 :white_check_mark:
mike: thanks. schedule unpin for 30m after additional smoke tests. @anna please coordinate release notes.
anna: noted. I'll add a line: 'hotfix: short rollback to previous image due to missing prod secret; secret synced; unpin pending smoke tests'.
jordan: :thumbsup: closing incident, but let's add a checklist to avoid helm-values drift between envs.
